specification.title: Unsupported references fail before persistence
specification.description: Unsupported ReportWriter reference: the model output references a research claim that was never supplied. Deterministic provenance validation must fail, no report may be persisted, and no report pointer may advance.
specification.purpose: Verify deterministic provenance validation rejects a model output referencing a research claim that was never supplied: no report is persisted and no report pointer advances.
specification.operational_relevance: Reference integrity is what makes reports trustworthy enough to act on.
specification.regression_risk: The writer could persist a report citing material outside the supplied input.

required: The report execution fails with the unsupported-reference error before persistence
No report is persisted for the investigation
forbidden: A report citing unsupplied material is persisted
